notes.en: Go-to for panels. Needs a SOM student as the requester.

notes.en: Used for the 2025 gala, ~$18/head; confirm headcount 2 weeks out. Ask separately for vegetarian options.

notes.en: Co-hosts the visa/status session in orientation week. Start coordinating in June.

notes.en: Cheap but slow; order a week ahead for big events.

notes.en: Free venue for Beijing alumni events; apply 4 weeks ahead and state the Yale connection.
